cnTitle: 流年走太阴：这一年想慢下来细经营，怎么把柔劲用成积累
enTitle: A Tai Yin Year: Slowing Down to Refine, Turning Soft Care Into Accumulation
enDesc: When Tai Yin hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans inward: refined, home-focused and taste-conscious, with a keener eye than usual, suiting deep expertise, home and money care and repairing relationships. The strength is fine perception and the ability to nurture; the risk is emotional drain, overthinking and hesitation. The key is directing refinement into concrete tasks and setting a rhythm, remembering that an annual year sets only one year and sits beneath the natal chart and decade.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由太阴主事，这一年基调偏「内敛、细腻、顾家、重审美」，心思比平时细，适合深耕专业、打理家宅与财务、修复关系。好处是感知强、能守能养，风险是情绪内耗、想多做少、被动犹豫；关键是把细腻落到具体事上、给自己定节奏，并记住流年只管一年、在本命大限之下。

cnTitle: 流年走天同：这一年想过得松一点，怎么把舒服过成不松散
enTitle: A Tian Tong Year: Wanting More Ease, Enjoying Comfort Without Slacking
enDesc: When Tian Tong hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans gentle, feeling-oriented and relational, with relatively low pressure, suiting service, creativity, education and approachability-based work. The strength is good rapport, enjoying the process and treating people well; the risk is slack, procrastination and letting chances pass. The key is setting small goals and deadlines within the ease rather than letting the year slip by comfortably.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由天同主事，这一年基调偏「缓和、重感受、讲人情」，压力相对小，适合服务、创意、文教与靠亲和力的事。好处是人缘好、能享受过程、愿意对人好，风险是松散拖延、安于现状、机会来了懒得接；关键是在舒服里给自己立小目标和截止时间，别让一年在轻松里滑过。

cnTitle: 流年走廉贞：这一年人情规则都变复杂，怎么把分寸用成正事
enTitle: A Lian Zhen Year: When Rules and Relationships Get Complex, Using Tact Well
enDesc: When Lian Zhen hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to rules, sociability, tact and experience: one must network, follow the rules and find chances within relationships, suiting management, law and enforcement, public relations and fields requiring tact. The strength is broad connections, knowing the rules and gaining experience; the risk is disputes, contract trouble and romantic tangles. The key is holding written contracts and boundaries, keeping evidence for promises and using social skill for real work.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由廉贞主事，这一年基调偏「规则、交际、分寸与历练」，要打交道、守规矩、在关系里找机会，适合管理、政法、公关、文化等需要分寸的事。好处是交际广、懂规则、能历练，风险是口舌官非、合约纠纷与感情纠葛；关键是守住书面合约与边界，重要承诺留证据，把交际用在正事上。

cnTitle: 流年走天相：这一年靠协调配合，怎么把事理顺也不丢主张
enTitle: A Tian Xiang Year: Coordinating and Supporting, Keeping Things Smooth and Your Own View
enDesc: When Tian Xiang hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to partnership, coordination and smoothing things within a structure, suiting administration, human resources, legal affairs, operations and supporting roles. The strength is steadiness, tact and settling people and affairs; the risk is passively following others, holding back views and being pushed along. The key is proposing plans within support and building one hard skill to move from helper to someone irreplaceable.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由天相主事，这一年基调偏「配合、协调、在体系里把事理顺」，适合行政、人事、法务、运营与辅佐型角色。好处是稳、懂分寸、能安顿人和事，风险是被动随人、有主张不说、被推着走；关键是在配合中主动提方案，练一项硬本事，让自己从帮手变成不可替代的人。

cnTitle: 流年走天梁：这一年想把事做对，怎么把原则用成帮助而非说教
enTitle: A Tian Liang Year: Wanting to Do Things Right, Turning Principles Into Help Not Lectures
enDesc: When Tian Liang hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to setting principles, building expertise and guiding others, suiting education, medicine, law, consulting and senior roles, and favoring exams and credentials. The strength is steadiness, catching people and easy trust; the risk is proud isolation and lecturing. The key is turning principles and experience into concrete help and plans, with fewer grand speeches and more actionable steps.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由天梁主事，这一年基调偏「立原则、讲专业、照顾和督导他人」，适合教育、医疗、法律、咨询与资深岗，利考证与资格。好处是稳重、能兜底、易得信任，风险是孤高、好为人师、说教感重；关键是把原则和经验做成具体帮助与方案，少讲大道理，多给可执行的办法。

cnTitle: 流年走巨门：这一年话变多变爱较真，怎么把表达用成资本
enTitle: A Ju Men Year: Talking and Questioning More, Turning Expression Into Capital
enDesc: When Ju Men hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to expression, analysis, research and questioning, suiting teaching, communication, law, consulting, research and content, often bringing matters that need arguing through. The strength is strong logic, depth and penetrating expression; the risk is disputes, saying too much and bluntness. The key is grounding expression in expertise, making it into work, pausing before speaking and keeping important communication in writing.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由巨门主事，这一年基调偏「表达、辨析、研究与追问」，适合教学、传播、法律、咨询、研究与内容，容易遇到要辩明的事。好处是逻辑强、挖得深、表达有穿透力，风险是口舌是非、言多必失、说话太直；关键是把表达接到专业上、做成作品，开口前停一下，重要沟通留书面。

cnTitle: 流年遇官符：合同规则变多的一年，怎么守好书面与合规
enTitle: A Guan Fu Year: When Contracts and Rules Multiply, Holding to Paperwork and Compliance
enDesc: Guan Fu governs rules, constraints, contracts, systems and official pressure. In a Guan Fu year, signing, approvals, compliance and duty-related matters increase; handled well they bring responsibility and standing, handled poorly they bring fines, disputes or friction. The key is putting important matters in writing, reading the terms, staying compliant on time and seeking professional legal counsel for major contracts rather than relying on words or assumptions.
cnDesc: 官符主规则、约束、合同、制度与职务压力，流年逢官符，这一年签约、审批、合规、职务相关的事会变多，处理得好是责任与名分落地，处理不好易有罚款、纠纷或口舌。关键是重要事项一律走书面、看清条款、按时合规，重大合约以专业律师意见为准，不靠口头和想当然。

cnTitle: 流年遇晦气：误会和低潮偏多的一年，怎么少硬碰、把话说开
enTitle: A Hui Qi Year: When Misunderstandings and Low Moods Mount, Easing Off and Speaking Clearly
enDesc: Hui Qi governs gloom, stagnation, misunderstandings and low spirits. In a Hui Qi year it is easy to feel unmotivated without a clear cause and to be misunderstood, with higher communication costs. The key is not forcing clashes while emotional, saying what needs saying early and plainly, and allowing enough rest; Long De and auspicious stars ease it. It is only an annual layer and does not set long-term results.
cnDesc: 晦气主晦暗、暗滞、误会与心情低落，流年逢晦气，这一年容易觉得「明明没大事却提不起劲、容易被误解」，沟通成本变高。关键是别在情绪里硬碰硬，把该说的话及早、平实说清楚，留足休整，若见龙德与吉曜则易化解；它只是年度临时层，不主长期结果。

cnTitle: 流年遇小耗：琐碎开销偏多的一年，怎么做预算、留缓冲
enTitle: A Xiao Hao Year: When Small Expenses Pile Up, Budgeting and Keeping a Buffer
enDesc: Xiao Hao governs small losses, minor expenses and small plan delays. In a Xiao Hao year, scattered spending and small things slowing plans are common, but they usually do not hurt the foundation. The key is tracking budgets and cash flow, keeping a buffer for surprises and not worrying over small sums. It is only an annual layer while the major stars and transformations set long-term finances, and money matters still follow licensed institutions and official product terms.
cnDesc: 小耗主小额损耗、琐碎支出与计划小阻，流年逢小耗，这一年容易有零散开销、计划被小事拖慢，但通常不伤根本。关键是把预算和流水记清楚、给意外留缓冲、不为小钱焦虑；它只是年度临时层，主星四化才主长期财运，理财仍以持牌机构和正规产品说明为准。

cnTitle: 流年逢岁破：与太岁相冲的变动年，怎么求稳、别在冲动下做决定
enTitle: A Sui Po Year: A Clash-Year of Change, Seeking Stability and Avoiding Impulsive Decisions
enDesc: Sui Po always sits opposite the year’s Tai Sui and clashes with it, governing major change, breaks, overturned plans and turbulence. In a Sui Po year, sudden shifts in work, housing, relationships or partnerships are common. The key is postponing big matters, avoiding irreversible decisions under emotion or pressure, leaving room and preparing alternatives. A clash can also open a deadlock, and the point is adjusting with the current rather than forcing it.
cnDesc: 岁破永远在太岁的对宫、与当年太岁相冲，主大变动、决裂、计划推翻与环境动荡，流年逢岁破，这一年容易遇到工作、住处、关系或合作的突变。关键是大事缓办、别在情绪和压力下做不可逆决定，主动留余地、备好替代方案；冲也能冲开僵局，重在顺势调整而非硬顶。

cnTitle: 流年逢龙德：逢凶易有救的一年，怎么借转圜修复关系、重启局面
enTitle: A Long De Year: When Trouble Finds Rescue, Using Turnaround to Repair and Restart
enDesc: Long De governs turning trouble into safety, benefactors, returns and room to resolve. In a Long De year, when deadlocks or trouble appear, someone often mediates, a second chance arises or space to ease opens, suiting repairing relationships, resolving disputes and restarting stalled matters. The key is offering a graceful way out, keeping dignity and not making words final. It is an annual auspicious star but not all-powerful, and the major stars, transformations and real action still matter.
cnDesc: 龙德主逢凶化吉、贵人、回头与转圜，流年逢龙德，这一年遇到僵局或麻烦时，容易有人出面调解、出现第二次机会或缓和余地，利于修复关系、化解纠纷、重启搁置的事。关键是主动给台阶、留体面、不把话说绝；它是年度吉星但非万能，仍要看主星四化与实际行动。

cnTitle: 流年逢岁建：太岁当值的主动年，怎么开创而不固执硬碰
enTitle: A Sui Jian Year: When the Year Commander Is on Duty, Initiating Without Stubborn Clashes
enDesc: Sui Jian is the Tai Sui itself on duty, governing initiative, new starts and self-reinforcement, and acting as an amplifier that makes both good and bad more visible. In a Sui Jian year, especially a birth-year year, one easily wants to call the shots and to clash stubbornly. The key is using initiative to advance real work, listening more, following rules and leaving room for cooperation, avoiding bravado and one-sided decisions. It is neutral, and the outcome depends on how you use the energy.
cnDesc: 岁建就是太岁本身当值，主这一年主动、开创、自我增强，也像放大器让好事坏事都更明显，流年逢岁建（尤其本命年）容易想自己说了算、也易固执硬碰。关键是把主动用在推进正事上，多听人劝、守规则、给合作留位置，忌逞强和独断；它是中性星，吉凶取决于你怎么用这股劲。

cnTitle: 紫微用四化看「你靠什么赚钱」：禄权科落宫定位收入方式
enTitle: Using the Four Transformations to See What You Earn From: Where Lu, Quan and Ke Land
enDesc: To see what someone earns from, do not fixate on the Wealth Palace alone; read where the natal Hua Lu, Hua Quan and Hua Ke land together with the Life, Wealth and Career palaces: Hua Lu often points to resources and opportunity, Hua Quan to control and professional authority, Hua Ke to reputation and credentials. The key is locating your main income model and then making it real through action. This is a tendency, not a fixed result; money matters follow licensed institutions and official product terms and this is not investment advice.
cnDesc: 看一个人靠什么赚钱，不能只盯财帛宫，要把生年化禄、化权、化科落在哪几宫，连同命宫、财帛、官禄一起读：化禄多指向资源与机会、化权指向掌控与专业话语权、化科指向名声与专业背书。关键是定位收入主模式，再用行动做实；这是倾向不是定数，理财以持牌机构和正规产品说明为准，不构成投资建议。

cnTitle: 紫微看四化：钱怎么从财帛「流」进田宅，过路钱和沉淀资产的差别
enTitle: Reading the Transformations: How Money Flows From Wealth Into Property, Passing Cash vs Stored Assets
enDesc: The Wealth Palace governs how money moves in and out, while the Property Palace governs whether it settles into assets, home and security. Whether Hua Lu or Hua Quan lands in Wealth or Property means quite different things: Lu in Wealth often means smooth earning and lively cash flow, while Lu in Property means money is retained and tends toward real estate and accumulation. The key is first giving Wealth a source, then guiding part of it to settle in Property rather than only passing through. This is a structural tendency and not investment advice, and property and finance follow licensed institutions and official product terms.
cnDesc: 财帛宫管钱怎么进出，田宅宫管钱能不能沉淀成资产、家与安全感，化禄化权落在财帛还是田宅含义很不同：禄入财帛多主赚得顺、现金流活，禄入田宅才主钱留得住、易置业积累。关键是先让财帛有源头，再引导一部分沉淀进田宅，别让钱只过路；这是结构倾向，不构成投资建议，置产理财以持牌机构和正规产品说明为准。

cnTitle: 紫微看合作：合伙的四化怎么「主持」，先把分工、话语权和退出讲清
enTitle: Reading Cooperation: How to Host the Partnership Transformations, Clarifying Roles, Authority and Exit
enDesc: In reading cooperation, where the transformations land on the Siblings and Friends line is key: Hua Lu often means willingness to share and harmony producing gain, Hua Quan means who leads and decides, Hua Ke means standing, reputation and dignity, while Hua Ji easily brings knots over interests and promises. The key is clarifying roles, contributions, authority, distribution and exit before starting and putting them in a written contract, valuing rules over feelings. In practice, rely on professional lawyers, proper channels and written contracts.
cnDesc: 看一段合作或合伙，四化落在兄弟、交友（兄友线）很关键：化禄多主愿意共享、和气生财，化权主谁主导、谁说了算，化科主名分、口碑与体面，化忌则易在利益承诺上生心结。关键是把分工、出资、话语权、分配和退出机制在开始前讲清并写进书面合同，重规则胜过靠感情；具体以专业律师和正规途径、书面合同为准。

cnTitle: 紫微零基础多久能看懂自己的盘：不必一次学全，先认宫位和命宫主星
enTitle: How Long Until a Beginner Can Read Their Own Zi Wei Chart: No Need to Learn It All at Once
enDesc: For a beginner to read their own chart, there is no need to first memorize a hundred stars and rhymes; usually learning the twelve palaces, the Life Palace major star and the triple-direction already gives a rough grasp of your temperament, then gradually add the transformations and cycles. The key is moving in steps, palaces to major stars to transformations to limits, while comparing everything with your own chart, neither chasing speed nor being intimidated by terms. It is a tool for self-observation, and its conclusions should not replace real action.
cnDesc: 零基础看懂自己的盘，不必先背上百颗星和口诀，通常认全十二宫、读懂命宫主星与三方四正，就能对自己的性格底色有个大致理解，再逐步加四化、大限流年。关键是按「宫位→主星→四化→运限」分步、边学边对照自己的盘，不追速成也不被术语吓退；命理是自我观察工具，结论别替现实行动做主。

cnTitle: 紫微看盘为什么要「先有问题、再看盘」：泛泛看最容易看花眼
enTitle: Why to Frame a Question Before Reading a Zi Wei Chart: Vague Reading Blurs Everything
enDesc: Trying to read all twelve palaces and a hundred stars at once most easily leads to confusion and random labels. A steadier approach is first locking one concrete question, such as whether these two years suit a job change or whether a relationship can last, then setting the taiji on the relevant palaces and gathering the triple-direction and transformations onto that line. The key is one question, one taiji, reading one clearly before moving to the next. The chart does not change, and the more specific the question, the more verifiable the answer.
cnDesc: 拿到一张盘就想把十二宫、上百颗星全看一遍，最容易越看越乱、乱贴标签。更稳的是先锁定一个具体问题（比如这两年适不适合换工作、这段关系能不能走下去），再以相关宫位立太极、把三方四正和四化收拢到这条线上。关键是「一事一太极」，一个问题看清再换下一个；盘不会变，问题越具体答案越可验证。

cnTitle: 紫微怎么给一个大运或流年提「主题词」：用主星加四化概括这阶段主线
enTitle: How to Give a Decade or Year a Theme Word: Summarizing the Stage With the Major Star and Transformations
enDesc: Reading a decade or a year does not require listing everything that happens; instead use the decade or year Life Palace major star, that layer’s transformations and the natal palace it overlaps to summarize one or two theme words, such as rebuilding order, expanding outward or repairing inward. A theme word is not a verdict but helps you grasp where effort is most worthwhile this stage. Specific events still combine the yearly and monthly layers and real action, and one year does not set long-term conclusions.
cnDesc: 看一个十年大运或某一流年，不必罗列所有会发生的事，而是用「大限/流年命宫主星 + 这一层四化 + 叠到本命的宫位」概括一两个主题词，比如「重建秩序」「向外拓展」「向内修复」。主题词不是断吉凶，而是帮你抓住这阶段最值得用力的方向；具体事件仍要结合流年逐月、落到行动，单一年运不主长期结论。

cnTitle: 紫微盘和现实对不上时怎么办：先查排盘、再查读盘，别急着否定
enTitle: When a Zi Wei Chart Does Not Match Reality: Check the Casting, Then the Reading
enDesc: When a chart does not seem to fit, do not rush to doubt the system; most issues lie in two places: the casting is wrong, from lunar conversion, leap months, early and late Zi hour, true solar time or birthplace, or the reading is wrong, from one star alone, ignoring the trine and transformations or treating a year as the natal chart. The key is checking item by item in order and rectifying the chart with personality and past events rather than forcing it on or rejecting it wholesale.
cnDesc: 觉得盘和自己对不上，先别急着怀疑命理，多数问题出在两个环节：一是排盘错了（农历换算、闰月、早晚子时、真太阳时、出生地），二是读盘错了（只看一颗星、忽略三方四化、把流年当本命）。关键是按顺序逐项排查、用性格和过往大事定盘，而不是硬把盘往身上套或全盘否定。

cnTitle: 紫微怎么练盘才会进步：用「先断后验」建立自己的反馈闭环
enTitle: How to Practice Zi Wei to Improve: Build a Feedback Loop by Judging First, Verifying Later
enDesc: Understanding theory is not the same as reading a chart, and real improvement comes from deliberate practice: take your own or a familiar chart, write judgments by method before knowing the outcome, then compare with what later happens and score where you were wrong or missed something. The key is reading widely, verifying promptly and reviewing repeatedly, linking every judgment back to stars, palaces and transformations rather than judging by feeling.
cnDesc: 看懂理论不等于会读盘，真正提高靠刻意练习：先拿自己或熟人的盘，在不知道结果前按方法写下判断，再用后来发生的事对照打分，看错在哪、漏了什么。关键是大量看、及时验、反复复盘，并把每个判断连回星曜、宫位与四化的依据，而不是凭感觉断。

cnTitle: 紫微格局：日月夹命，明暗两方面资源都来扶你的人怎么走得稳
enTitle: The Sun-and-Moon Framing Pattern: When Light and Shadow Both Support You, Walking Steadily
enDesc: Sun-and-Moon framing means the Sun and Moon flank the Life Palace from the Parents and Siblings palaces, bringing both visible and hidden, inner and outer, front-stage and back-stage support, usually meaning more help, broad perspective and people to assist. Yet the framing also depends on the stars’ brightness and whether malefics and Ji frame it too; fallen stars or voids discount the help. A pattern is a baseline, not a guarantee, and still combines with the triple-direction and later action.
cnDesc: 日月夹命指太阳、太阴分别在命宫两侧（父母宫与兄弟宫）夹拱，主明暗、内外、前后台资源都来相济，通常助力多、眼界宽、遇事有人帮。但夹宫也要看太阳太阴亮度、有无煞忌同夹，若夹的是落陷星或空劫，助力会打折；格局是底色不是保证书，仍要配合三方四正与后天行动。

cnTitle: 紫微格局：左辅右弼同宫，助力班底强的人怎么不变成依赖
enTitle: The Zuo Fu-You Bi Pattern: Strong Support, Without Turning It Into Dependence
enDesc: Zuo Fu and You Bi are a pair of assistant stars governing coordination, help and a supporting team; sharing or meeting the Life Palace means help comes easily, coordination is strong and team leadership suits you, with people to take things on. But assistant stars need a major star to be effective, and if the major star is weak with only the pair, one easily depends on others and cannot decide. The key is connecting others’ help to your own backbone rather than waiting to be arranged for.
cnDesc: 左辅右弼是一对主协调、助力与接班班底的辅星，同宫或会照命宫时，主一生易得人帮、善协调、适合带团队，遇事有人承接。但辅星要依附主星才有力，若主星弱、又只见辅弼，容易变成依赖他人、自己拿不定主意；关键是把别人的助力接到自己主心骨上，而不是等别人安排。

cnTitle: 紫微格局：四正同临，本宫与三方对宫一齐得力的饱满结构
enTitle: The Four-Direction Alignment: A Full Structure With the Home, Trine and Opposite All Strong
enDesc: Four-direction alignment means the home palace together with its opposite and two trine palaces are all well-placed with many auspicious and few malefic stars, giving a full pattern where resources, execution and pull answer one another, usually a steady structure. But holding depends on the net combination of all four positions, not just counting auspicious stars; if the opposite or trine is fallen with Ji and malefics, the apparent fullness breaks. The point is whether the whole forms joint force.
cnDesc: 四正同临指本宫连同对宫、两个三合宫星曜一齐得地、吉多煞少，主体格局饱满、资源执行牵引互相呼应，通常是较稳结构。但成格要看四个位置净组合，不能只数吉星数量，若对宫或三方落陷、见化忌煞星，表面齐美也会破；重点是整体能否形成合力。

cnTitle: 紫微十二宫的强弱怎么判断：不看单颗星，看净组合、四化与夹宫
enTitle: How to Judge the Strength of the Twelve Palaces: Not One Star, but Net Combination, Transformations and Framing
enDesc: Judging a palace’s strength is not just whether it has auspicious stars or a bright major star; combine the net stars of its triple-direction, whether the natal transformations land there, and whether the two flanking palaces are auspicious or harsh: auspicious meetings, transformation activation and clean framing make true force. Strength is not fixed and shifts as the decade and year activate it. It describes grounding in that field rather than directly equaling a good or bad result.
cnDesc: 判断一个宫位强不强，不能只看有没有吉星或主星亮不亮，要把三方四正星曜净组合、生年四化有没有落进来、两侧夹宫是吉是凶合起来看：吉星会聚、四化引动、夹宫干净才算真有力。强弱不是固定的，大限流年引动时会变化；它描述这一领域的底气，不直接等于吉凶结果。

cnTitle: 紫微哪些主星适合当领导：不是只有帝王星，不同主星有不同带队方式
enTitle: Which Major Stars Suit Leadership: Not Only the Emperor Star, Different Stars Lead Differently
enDesc: When it comes to leadership, many first think of Zi Wei and the Sun, the emperor and noble stars, but nearly every one of the fourteen major stars can lead a team, just in different styles: Zi Wei values authority and vision, the Sun illumination and openness, Tian Fu stewardship and resources, Qi Sha initiative and execution, Tian Ji planning and coordination. The key is not which star is guaranteed to lead, but recognizing your own style, filling gaps and building a team. Leadership is learnable, and star nature only gives a tendency.
cnDesc: 说到适合当领导，很多人第一反应是紫微、太阳这种「帝王星」「贵星」，但十四主星里几乎每颗都能带团队，只是风格不同：紫微重权威与格局、太阳重照亮与公开、天府重守成与资源、七杀重开创与执行、天机重谋划与协调。关键不是「哪颗星一定能当领导」，而是认清自己的带队风格、补上短板、搭好班底；领导能力是后天可练的，星性只给倾向。

cnTitle: 紫微主星会随年龄变化吗：同一颗星在二十岁和四十岁的表达方式很不一样
enTitle: Does Your Major Star Change With Age: The Same Star Expresses Very Differently at Twenty and Forty
enDesc: The Life Palace major star sets a lifelong temperament baseline, but a baseline is not fixed behavior. The same major star expresses noticeably differently at different ages and stages: when young, one easily amplifies the star’s weaknesses, such as impulsiveness, stubbornness or hesitation, while with experience one can better use the strengths and hold the shortcomings in check. The key is reading a person through three layers, baseline, stage and choices, rather than labeling them for life from one star. Growth is moving from instinctive reaction to skilled use of the star’s nature.
cnDesc: 命宫主星定的是一个人一生的性格底色，但底色不等于固定不变的行为——同一颗主星在不同年龄、不同人生阶段，表达方式会明显不同：年轻时容易把星性的短板放大（冲动、固执、犹豫），经历多了之后更能把长处用出来、把短处收住。关键是用「底色+阶段+选择」三层看一个人，而不是用一颗星给人贴终身标签；成长就是把星性从本能反应练成熟练运用。

cnTitle: 紫微看感情里当主动方：从命宫和夫妻宫看主动的分寸，别推进过度也别一味等
enTitle: Reading the Proactive Role in Relationships: Tact From the Life and Spouse Palaces, Neither Pushing Too Hard Nor Waiting Forever
enDesc: Who takes the initiative in a relationship and how far it goes relates closely to the star combination of the Life and Spouse palaces: a pioneering Life star, such as Qi Sha, Po Jun or Lian Zhen, easily initiates but may rush, while an inward one, such as Tai Yin, Tian Xiang or Tian Liang, easily waits passively but may miss chances. The key is first recognizing your own initiative pattern, then reading the receptive rhythm of the other person’s Spouse Palace, using initiative for expression and creating chances rather than forcing an answer. A relationship is two people’s rhythm, and one-sided initiative or waiting easily loses balance.
cnDesc: 感情里谁主动、主动到什么程度，和命宫、夫妻宫的星性组合很有关系：命宫主星偏开创（七杀、破军、廉贞）容易主动推进但可能太急，偏内敛（太阴、天相、天梁）容易被动等待但可能错过。关键是先认清自己的主动模式，再看对方夫妻宫的接受节奏，把主动用在「表达和创造机会」上，而不是「逼对方给答案」；感情是两个人的节奏，单方面的主动或等待都容易失衡。

cnTitle: 紫微主星怎么当父母：不同主星的教养风格，别把性格短板带进亲子关系
enTitle: How Each Major Star Parents: Different Teaching Styles, Keeping Personality Shortcomings Out of the Parent-Child Bond
enDesc: Once a person becomes a parent, the Life Palace star’s traits naturally enter parenting: Zi Wei easily values authority and rules, the Sun easily values performance and public recognition, Tai Yin easily values care and attentiveness, Qi Sha easily values results and efficiency. Every style has benefits, but each also easily projects its own shortcomings onto the child: too strict, too doting, too urgent, too controlling. The key is first recognizing your own parenting style, then distinguishing whether this is for the child’s good or your own anxiety and habit, giving the child space suited to their nature rather than shaping them into another version of yourself.
cnDesc: 当了父母之后，命宫主星的特质会自然带进教养里：紫微容易重权威和规矩、太阳容易重表现和公开认可、太阴容易重细腻和照顾、七杀容易重结果和效率。每种风格都有好处，但也都容易把自己的性格短板投射给孩子：太严、太宠、太急、太控制。关键是先认清自己的教养风格，再区分「这是为孩子好」还是「这是我自己的焦虑和习惯」，给孩子适合他天性的空间，而不是把孩子塑造成另一个自己。

cnTitle: 紫微怎么发挥自己主星的优势：先认清星性长短，再用环境和角色放大长处
enTitle: How to Leverage Your Major Star’s Strengths: First Know the Star’s Traits, Then Use Environment and Role to Amplify Them
enDesc: Many people reading a chart only care whether their star is good, but the more useful question is what their star’s strengths are and how to use them. Every major star has clear strengths and shortcomings: Zi Wei’s vision and command, the Sun’s warmth and openness, Tian Ji’s planning and flexibility, Tai Yin’s refinement and accumulation. The key is placing yourself in environments and roles where your strengths show, while using methods to fill gaps, rather than forcing it in unsuitable settings and spending all your energy fixing weaknesses.
cnDesc: 很多人看盘只关心「我这颗星好不好」，其实更有用的问题是「我这颗星的长处是什么、怎么用出来」。每颗主星都有明显的优势面和短板面：紫微的格局和统御、太阳的热情和公开、天机的谋划和灵活、太阴的细腻和积累，关键是把自己放到能发挥长处的环境和角色里，同时用方法补短板，而不是在不适合的场景里硬磕、把精力都花在改缺点上。

cnTitle: 紫微对宫和三方哪个更重要：分工不同，对宫主牵引、三方主资源执行
enTitle: Opposite Palace vs Trine Palaces: Different Roles, the Opposite Pulls, the Trine Supplies Resources and Execution
enDesc: When reading a palace, both the opposite palace and the two trine palaces matter, but their functions differ: the opposite palace sits directly across and governs pull, complement and the force of the opposite side, for example Life reading Migration or Wealth reading Karma. The trine sits one hundred and twenty degrees on either side and governs resources, execution and support, for example Life’s trine being Wealth and Career. One cannot simply say which matters more; it depends on the question: for external environment and relationships, weight the opposite; for resources and execution, weight the trine, and only together do they form a complete reading.
cnDesc: 看一个宫位时，对宫和两个三合宫（三方）都要看，但它们的功能不一样：对宫在本宫的正对面，主「牵引、互补、对立面的力量」，比如命宫看迁移、财帛看福德；三方在本宫两侧一百二十度，主「资源、执行、支撑」，比如命宫的三方是财帛和官禄。不能简单说哪个更重要，要看你问的是什么问题：问外部环境和关系重对宫，问资源和执行重三方，两者合起来才是完整判断。

cnTitle: 可以帮家人或别人看盘吗：可以练习，但要守边界、不替人做重大决定
enTitle: Can You Read Charts for Family and Others: Yes for Practice, but Keep Boundaries and Do Not Make Major Decisions for Them
enDesc: After learning Zi Wei, many want to read charts for family and friends, which is itself a good way to practice and show care, but several boundaries must be kept: first, do not make major decisions for others, such as quitting, separating, investing or treating illness, only offer angles and information; second, do not create anxiety or turn possibility into certainty; third, do not force readings when the other does not want to hear, respecting their receptive rhythm; fourth, for health, finance and legal matters, always recommend professionals. Chart reading is a tool for self-observation and reference, not a substitute for decisions, and when reading for others, saying this is reference up front matters even more.
cnDesc: 学了紫微之后，很多人想帮家人、朋友看看盘，这本身是练习和关心的好方式，但要守几条边界：一是不替人做重大决定（辞职、分手、投资、治病），只提供角度和信息；二是不制造焦虑，不把可能性说成必然；三是对方不想听时不硬讲，尊重对方的接受节奏；四是涉及健康、财务、法律的事，一定要建议找专业人士。看盘是自我观察和参考工具，不是决策替代，帮别人看更要把「这是参考」说在前面。

cnTitle: 紫微排盘需要准备什么信息：出生年月日时、出生地、性别，以及定盘用的过往大事
enTitle: What Information Is Needed to Cast a Zi Wei Chart: Birth Date, Time, Place, Gender, Plus Past Events for Rectification
enDesc: To cast a Zi Wei chart, the basic information is birth year, month, day, time, birthplace and gender, but these alone are not fully stable. Because hour boundaries, early and late Zi hour, true solar time and leap months can shift the chart, you also need several past major events, schooling, work, relationships, moves and illness, to rectify and verify. The key is the more accurate the information the better; if the hour is uncertain, cast several candidate charts and reverse-engineer from major events, and confirm that casting tools and calendar settings match, avoiding one using lunar and another solar.
cnDesc: 排一张紫微盘，基础信息是出生年、月、日、时、出生地和性别，但光有这些还不够稳——因为时辰交界、早晚子时、真太阳时、闰月等问题可能让盘偏掉，所以还需要准备几件过往大事（升学、工作、婚恋、搬迁、伤病等）用来定盘核对。关键是信息越准确越好，时辰不确定就多排几个候选盘、用大事反推；排盘工具和历法设置也要确认一致，避免一个用农历一个用公历。

cnTitle: 紫微截空在命宫：兴趣广但不易执着的人，怎么把「空」用成专注和留白
enTitle: Jie Kong in the Life Palace: Broad Interests Yet Low Attachment, Turning Emptiness Into Focus and Space
enDesc: People with Jie Kong, the road-cutting void star, in the Life Palace often come across as having broad interests, taking things lightly and not clinging hard to people or matters. The strengths are not getting stuck ina dead end, being able to let go, and having an artistic and philosophical temperament; the risk is short-lived enthusiasm, easily giving up halfway and seeming unreliable. The key is using the energy of void in the right place: for letting go of obsessions, leaving space in life, and doing work needing creativity and taste, while using methods such as deadlines, small goals and partners to manage attention that easily scatters. Jie Kong is an assistant star, and the final verdict still rests on the Life major star and trine.
cnDesc: 截空（截路空亡）在命宫的人，常给人一种「兴趣广、想得开、对人事物不易死磕」的感觉，好处是不钻牛角尖、能放下、有艺术和哲思气质，风险是三分钟热度、做事容易半途而废、给人不踏实的印象。关键是把「空」的能量用对地方：用在放下执念、给生活留白、做需要创意和审美的事，同时用方法（deadline、小目标、搭档）管住容易散的注意力；截空是辅星，最终仍以命宫主星和三方为主断。

cnTitle: 紫微月德在官禄宫：工作上逢纠纷易有转圜的人，怎么靠厚道和合规化解职场摩擦
enTitle: Yue De in the Career Palace: When Workplace Disputes Easily Find Resolution, Using Integrity and Compliance to Ease Friction
enDesc: Yue De is an auspicious star governing turning trouble into safety, benefactors, hidden virtue and turnaround. When it lands in the Career Palace, workplace disputes, misunderstandings and evaluation pressure easily find a second chance, someone to mediate or room to ease. The strength is good workplace rapport and rarely being cornered; the risk is relaxing attention to rules and evidence because there is always a way out. The key is combining Yue De’s turnaround power with integrity and compliance: keep paperwork for important matters, follow processes, do not take unfair advantage, and when friction arisesproactively offer a graceful way out, so Yue De’s fortune truly lands. It is an assistant star, and the final verdict still rests on the Career major star and trine.
cnDesc: 月德是一颗主逢凶化吉、贵人、阴德与转圜的吉星，落在官禄宫时，工作上遇到纠纷、误会、考核压力时，容易出现第二次机会、有人出面调解或事情有缓和余地。好处是职场人缘较好、遇事不易走到绝路，风险是因为总有转圜而放松对规则和证据的重视。关键是把月德的「转圜力」和「厚道合规」结合起来：重要事项留书面、守流程、不占便宜，遇到摩擦时主动给台阶，月德的吉才会真正落地；它是辅星，仍以官禄宫主星和三方为主断。

cnTitle: 紫微天才在福德宫：心思快、好奇、重智性享受的人，怎么把聪明收成一两样钻研
enTitle: Tian Cai in the Karma Palace: Quick Mind, Curiosity and Intellectual Enjoyment, Focusing Brilliance Into One or Two Deep Pursuits
enDesc: Tian Cai is an assistant star governing intelligence, ingenuity, inspiration and intellect. When it lands in the Karma Palace, one’s inner spiritual world is rich, the mind is quick, one is curious about knowledge and new things, and one enjoys the process of thinking and learning. The strengths are strong comprehension, creativity and a rich inner life; the risk is interests scattering too widely, wanting to learn everything but going deep in nothing, and being too clever for one’s own good. The key is directing Tian Cai’s energy from breadth to depth: choose one or two directions of genuine interest to cultivate deeply, use work and output to settle the intelligence, while leaving enough room for spiritual enjoyment. Tian Cai is an assistant star, and the final verdict still rests on the Karma major star and trine.
cnDesc: 天才是一颗主聪明、机巧、灵感和智性的辅星，落在福德宫时，人的内在精神世界丰富、心思快、对知识和新鲜事物好奇、享受思考和学习的过程。好处是领悟力强、有创意、精神生活不枯燥，风险是兴趣太发散、什么都想学却什么都不深、聪明反被聪明误。关键是把「天才」的能量从广度收向深度：选一两样真正感兴趣的方向深耕，用作品和输出把聪明沉淀下来，同时给精神享受留足空间；天才是辅星，仍以福德宫主星和三方为主断。

cnTitle: 紫微天使在迁移宫：外出时多「传递、接引、连接」型际遇的人，怎么把行程和信息做扎实
enTitle: Tian Shi in the Migration Palace: Travel Bringing Transmission, Reception and Connection, Making Itineraries and Information Solid
enDesc: Tian Shi is an assistant star governing transmission, reception, messages, connection and having a mission away from home. When it lands in the Migration Palace, travel, long trips and changing environments easily bring encounters of transmitting information, making connections and linking networks, and one often feels there is something to do and a role to play away from home. The strengths are many opportunities when traveling, easily receiving information and connections; the risk is little support away from home, itineraries easily going wrong and information being miscommunicated. The key is combining Tian Shi’s connecting power with solid preparation: before traveling, arrange itineraries, information and contacts, confirm important information in writing, and while awayproactively build connections without relying on others. Tian Shi is an assistant star, and the final verdict still rests on the Migration major star and trine.
cnDesc: 天使是一颗主传递、接引、消息、连接和「在外有使命」的辅星，落在迁移宫时，外出、远行、换环境时容易遇到传递信息、接引对接、连接人脉的际遇，也常觉得在外有事情要做、有角色要扮演。好处是外出时机会多、容易接到信息和人脉，风险是在外少援、行程容易出岔、信息传递有误。关键是把「天使」的连接力和「扎实准备」结合：外出前把行程、信息、接应人安排好，重要信息书面确认，在外主动建立连接但不依赖他人；天使是辅星，仍以迁移宫主星和三方为主断。

cnTitle: 紫微怎么看加薪谈判的时机：看官禄财帛和流年四化，把握绩效与预算窗口
enTitle: How to Time a Salary Raise Negotiation: Reading Career, Wealth and Annual Transformations for Performance and Budget Windows
enDesc: When negotiating a raise, timing matters more thantalking points. From the chart, combine the Career Palace, work performance and platform, the Wealth Palace, income and bargaining room, and the annual transformations, whether the year activates wealth opportunities, to judge: when the decade or year Hua Lu or Hua Quan enters Career or Wealth, and the year runs under auspicious stars such as Zi Wei, the Sun, Tian Fu or Tai Yin, it is usually a window when performance is seen and budget has room. When Hua Ji enters Career or Wealth or the year runs heavy with malefics, it is better to hold steady and not push. The key is aligning the chart’s timing with real performance cycles and company budgettiming, preparing performance data and market rates in advance, and grounding the negotiation in concrete contributions and reasonable expectations. This does not constitute career or financial advice, and specifics follow individual circumstances and company policy.
cnDesc: 想谈加薪，时机比话术更重要。从盘上看，要结合官禄宫（工作表现和平台）、财帛宫（收入和议价空间）、流年四化（当年有没有引动财禄的机会）来判断：大限或流年化禄、化权入官禄或财帛，且流年走吉星（紫微、太阳、天府、太阴等）时，通常是绩效被看见、预算有空间的窗口期；化忌入官禄财帛或流年走煞星重时，则宜稳守、不宜强谈。关键是把盘上的时机和现实的绩效周期、公司预算节奏对齐，提前准备业绩数据和市场行情，谈判落到具体贡献和合理预期上；这不构成职业或财务建议，具体以个人实际情况和公司政策为准。

cnTitle: 紫微怎么看转行到全新领域：区分可迁移能力和从零起步，重节奏与缓冲
enTitle: How to Read Switching to an Entirely New Field: Distinguishing Transferable Skills From Starting From Zero, With Rhythm and Buffer
enDesc: Switching to an entirely new field is a major decision. From the chart, combine the Career Palace, existing professional foundation, the Life Palace, temperament and core abilities, the Migration Palace, ability to adapt to new environments, and the decade and year, whether the current stage supports change, to judge: when the decade or year runs pioneering stars such as Qi Sha, Po Jun, Lian Zhen or Tan Lang and Hua Quan or Hua Lu enters Career or Migration, it is usually a stage suited toproactively seeking change; when running steady stars such as Tian Fu, Tian Xiang or Tian Liang and Hua Ji enters Career, it is better to hold steady or transition gradually. The key is distinguishing transferable skills from starting from zero, leaving enough learning buffer and financial buffer, and not quitting without a plan to force the switch. This does not constitute career advice, and specifics follow individual circumstances and market conditions.
cnDesc: 转行到全新领域是重大决定，从盘上看要结合官禄宫（原有职业基础）、命宫（性格和核心能力）、迁移宫（适应新环境的能力）、大限流年（当前阶段是否支持变动）来判断：大限或流年走开创型星（七杀、破军、廉贞、贪狼）且化权化禄入官禄迁移时，通常是适合主动求变的阶段；走守成型星（天府、天相、天梁）且化忌入官禄时，则宜稳守或渐进过渡。关键是区分「可迁移能力」和「从零起步」，给自己留足学习缓冲和经济缓冲，不要裸辞硬转；这不构成职业建议，具体以个人实际情况和市场环境为准。

cnTitle: 紫微怎么判断创业时机：命财官加田宅看扛风险能力，再看大限流年有没有机会
enTitle: How to Judge the Timing for Starting a Business: Life, Wealth, Career and Property for Risk Capacity, Then the Decade and Year for Opportunity
enDesc: Starting a business is a high-risk decision, and from the chart one cannot only look at whether there is opportunity, but more importantly whether one can withstand risk. Combine the Life Palace, temperament and stress resistance, the Wealth Palace, cash flow and financial ability, the Career Palace, professional ability and resources, and the Property Palace, resource foundation and risk reserve, to judge the foundation, then see whether the decade and year transformations activate entrepreneurial opportunity: when the decade or year Hua Lu or Hua Quan enters Life, Wealth, Career or Property, and runs pioneering stars such as Qi Sha, Po Jun, Lian Zhen or Tan Lang, it is usually a stage where opportunity and ability resonate; when Hua Ji enters Wealth or Property or runs steady stars, it is better to hold steady or test in small steps. The key is first assessing risk capacity before looking at opportunity, leaving enough cash flow and a way out, and not going all in. This does not constitute investment or entrepreneurship advice, and specifics follow individual circumstances and market conditions.
cnDesc: 创业是高风险决策，从盘上看不能只看「有没有机会」，更要看「扛不扛得住风险」。要结合命宫（性格和抗压）、财帛宫（现金流和理财能力）、官禄宫（事业能力和资源）、田宅宫（资源底座和抗风险储备）来判断基础，再看大限流年四化有没有引动创业机会：大限或流年化禄、化权入命财官田，且走开创型星（七杀、破军、廉贞、贪狼）时，通常是机会和能力共振的阶段；化忌入财帛田宅或走守成型星时，则宜稳守或小步试水。关键是先评估扛风险能力再看机会，留足现金流和退路，不all in；这不构成投资或创业建议，具体以个人实际情况和市场环境为准。

cnTitle: 紫微好运为什么没感觉：可能落在你没关注的领域、被煞忌打折、或需要行动配合
enTitle: Why Good Fortune Does Not Feel Like It: It May Land in Areas You Ignore, Be Discounted by Malefics, or Need Action to Activate
enDesc: Many feel that these years are said to be good fortune, so why do I not feel it, but good fortune does not mean everything goes smoothly or happens automatically. There are three common reasons: first, good fortune lands in an area you do not focus on, for example Hua Lu entering the Siblings Palace means good rapport and cooperation, but you only watch wealth; second, good fortune is discounted by malefics or fallen stars, the auspicious star arrives but shares the palace with malefics and Hua Ji, partially offsetting its force; third, good fortune needs action to activate, opportunity arrives but you do not move, so it remains only possibility rather than result. The key is first seeing which palace the good fortune lands in and what field it corresponds to, then seeing whether it is discounted, and finally using action to receive it. Astrology gives tendency and rhythm, not automatically fulfilled results.
cnDesc: 很多人觉得「这几年运势说好，为什么我没感觉」，其实好运不等于事事顺心、也不等于自动发生。常见原因有三种：一是好运落在了你没关注的领域（比如化禄入兄弟宫，是人缘和合作好，但你只盯着财运）；二是好运被煞忌或落陷打折（吉星虽到，但同宫有煞星化忌，力量被抵消一部分）；三是好运需要行动配合（机会来了但你没动，好运就只是「可能性」而不是「结果」）。关键是先看好运落在哪一宫、对应什么领域，再看有没有被打折，最后用行动去接；命理是倾向和节奏，不是自动兑现的结果。
